author: JKawesome
body:
Hey guys! X_Heat and I have been working on a new map, with help from some other players, and here's how it looks so far. I do need some suggestions, like what structures I should add, since it seems really flat right now. We also need some name suggestions.







Complete album can be viewed here: http://imgur.com/a/QDYWR
